run_portfolio_optimization: run the portfolio_optimization function to compute return and volatility for given weights
run_evaluate: run the evaluate function to score a portfolio using weighted return and volatility
run_objective: run the objective function to normalize weights and report portfolio loss to Ray Tune
run_nevergrad_optimizer: run the Nevergrad CMA optimizer to find the Pareto front for bi-objective portfolio optimization
run_raytune_nevergrad: run Ray Tune with NevergradSearch to optimize portfolio weights across multiple samples
